name: Stable Normal
description: Low, steady traffic representing normal cluster operation.

name: Moderate Load
description: Moderate concurrency representing a dynamically loaded cluster.

name: Burst Spike
description: Short high-intensity request surge creating transient contention.

name: Sustained Stress
description: Prolonged high concurrency representing near-saturation load.

name: Priority Conflict
description: Mixed request priorities and deadlines for QoS-aware routing.

name: Adaptive Multi-Phase
description: Multi-stage dynamic workload transitioning across traffic regimes.
